```ts
interface AdvanceWindow { fromWeek: Week; toWeek: Week; advanceNonce?: string /* when the host's advance epoch is lit: a second key beside `hostSeq` */; hostSeq: number /* the host's pulse-history sequence of the window's final record: the window's key ALWAYS, the advance nonce keying it too where the epoch is lit (J400 (5)) */; seq: number }   // each half of a window comes from the host unit that owns it (J400 (5); V13 §8.5): the polity window from its polity facts' unit (H13), the lens window's rows through its one projection of its ledgers, whose wire form is its presentation messages (H23; H17), the events window from its docket's committed receipts with their cause parents (H9); the birth window's halves likewise, and the host's week-zero call a registered no-op until its port client exists (H4)
interface PolityFacts { window: AdvanceWindow; seats: PolitySeat[]; links: PolityLink[]; relations: PolityRelation[]; sites: PolitySite[]; satellites: PolitySatellite[] /* J384 (11) */;
  claims: { by: string; target: string; kind: 'lineage'|'vengeance'|'grievance'; since: Week; expires?: Week; audience: Aud }[] /* a seat's standing claim on another seat as a dated pairwise fact (J397 (M20); H45): a lineage claim of a founding parent on its child or the reverse (a war reason the host computes only while its lineage lane is lit), a vengeance licence the razed town's friends hold against its razer (`expires` its lapse week), a sold town's grievance against its seller (dropped when the host's record decays) — each a DM-only claim outline of the target's sway in the claimant's colour that moves no cell, drawn until `expires` or the row's retraction (V13 §3.9 (12), §5.1); every row folded DM-only whatever audience the host sends */;
  culture: { a: string; b: string; band: 0|1|2|3|4|5; sampled?: Week /* the week the host sampled the band, where it records one */ }[] /* the host's own culture distance between two seats in fifths, in its plain form over its whole vector — no trade tie (J384 (2)) — for every pair within the host's reinforcement band or at its neighbour tier ≤ 2 — pairs the host can name itself; a pair not sent reads 0 (`W_POLITY_CULTURE_ABSENT`); J382 */;
  waterLanes: { lit: boolean; lanes: { a: string; b: string }[] } /* the host's adopted water lanes and whether its lane system is lit; J382 */;
  roadWatch: { edge: string; power: string; kind: 'closed'|'warden'; since: Week }[]; christened: { root: string; name: string }[];
  walk?: { seat: string; root: string; liege?: string; tier: string /* the host's own word through the adapter folder's link table */; class: string; basis: string; covert?: boolean /* the host's own: a membership it holds hidden — drawn as a covert link is, on the DM's picture alone; a player's or the public's picture treats the seat as rooting its own allegiance (V13 §3.9 (12); T-V13-41 (j)) */ }[] /* THE HOST'S MEMBERSHIP WALK per seat (J400 (6); V13 §8.5's H13): the host's one membership read — the allegiance root the seat belongs to (`root`, a seat key), its immediate liege where it has one (`liege`), its tier (`tier`), its polity class (`class`) and the basis of its membership (`basis`: vassalage, an occupation at its vassalized rung, a puppet seat, a tribute …), the class and the basis through the adapter folder's link table, each field the host's; where sent, the sway's allegiance roots and member links read it (V13 §3.9 (9)) and the map derives no kingdom of its own beside it — the raw `links` stay, read for the DM's diagnostic (the clerk, `whyCell`) and as the arm where no walk is sent; a walk row whose membership rests on a raw link sent `covert` is covert too; a seat the walk names as its own root roots its own allegiance, and a seat the walk omits reads its raw links (the arm), never rooting itself by omission */ }   // NO HOST NAME FOR AN ALLEGIANCE (J400 (2)): the host mints no polity name — a realm is named only by the DM's naming act, which reaches the map as a christening (`christened`); the host's realm past may OFFER a pencilled name, and the DM's confirm of it is that act, arriving as a christening like any other; the sway's label reads the christening, else the descriptive label from the root's name (V13 §3.9 (17), §5.9 (2)); the former optional host name (file v item 1086) is withdrawn and no field of this record carries one
interface PolitySeat { seat: string; tier: Rung; sizeThird: 0|1|2 /* the third of the tier's population band the seat's own people fall in — its satellites' people never counted (J384 (11)) */;
  prosperity: number /* the host's rung, 0 lowest; the sway reads it relative to the realm's held median (V13 §3.9 (7); J384 (1)) */;
  strengthBand?: 0|1|2|3|4 /* the host's own settlement-strength comparator — the one its relationship drift reads to choose a raider and an overlord — in fifths by its own strength banding (the one its envoys read); the adversarial push defers to it (V13 §3.9 (8); J384 (3)); absent until the host sends it */;
  military?: { forceBand: 0|1|2|3|4 /* the host's capacity facets bar the economy facet (manpower, institutions, materiel, logistics, will — prosperity counted once, J384 (4)), renormalised and banded on its existing five latent-strength floors */; garrisonPresent: boolean /* its garrison institution present */; netForce?: 0|1|2|3|4 /* the same band net of the blocks the host's ledger records as away in another's army — sent once its war-contribution design lands (H46; J397 (M17)) */; basis: 'gross'|'net' /* which the host sent: `gross` until H46; `memberForce` reads `netForce` when present, else `forceBand`, and the legend prints the basis (V13 §3.9 (10)) */ } /* absent until the host sends it (V13 §8.5) */;
  since?: Week /* the week the row's rungs last changed, where the host records it; absent: the window's start */;
  changes?: { field: 'tier'|'prosperity'|'force'|'strength'|'garrison'; value: number; week: Week }[] /* optional, the host's choice: the window's dated rung changes (V13 §3.9 (13)) */ }
interface PolityLink { from?: string /* absent: an occupation the host records with no occupier */; to: string;
  word: string /* the host's own word — a vassal label of its relationship-state plane (the plane its simulation reads; the regional plane is never sent), a subordinating treaty term's kind (tribute, compelled alliance, puppet seat, a treaty-held occupation) or an occupation's — mapped by the adapter folder's link table */;
  occupationRung?: number; heldByTreaty?: boolean /* an occupation the host holds by a treaty's ceded garrison: an overlay at its rung, never a member link (V13 §3.9 (12)) */; continuous?: boolean /* the host's own reach verdict, when it has one */; covert?: boolean; since: Week; sincePast?: PastRef /* a tie standing at week 0 whose host record dates it before the campaign: its fact reference and its years before the campaign, read through the host's past reader (J400 (14); V13 §8.5's H13); `since` then reads week 0, and the legend says "since n years before the campaign", never "since week 0" (V13 §5.1) */ }
interface PolityRelation { a: string; b: string /* sorted */; word: string /* the host's relationship-state label (the plane its simulation reads; the regional plane is never sent), mapped to respect, neutral or adversarial by the adapter folder's class table */; atWar: boolean; stance?: string /* the host's dated trade-stance word, mapped by the adapter folder's stance table; dark until the host sends it */;
  terms?: { kind: 'nonAggression'|'mutualDefence'|string /* the host's live pairwise treaty term by the adapter folder's term table; the two named are read by the class table (V13 §3.9 (8); J397 (M13)), any other kept for the clerk */; since: Week; enforced?: boolean /* whether the host's simulation yet enforces the term; absent or false, the legend notes the treaty is drawn as sworn */; pastFact?: PastRef /* a pact of the realm's past still standing at week 0: it enters the host's treaties at week 0, so its `since` is week 0, and it carries its past reference so the legend says "sworn n years before the campaign", never "since week 0" (J400 (14); H45); the adapter folder maps the host's own name for the reference onto this field */ }[] /* the pair's live treaty terms of the host's peacetime families, where sent (H45) */; since: Week; sincePast?: PastRef /* as `PolityLink.sincePast`: a relation standing at week 0 whose host record dates it before the campaign (J400 (14)) */ }
interface PolitySite { site: Id; holder?: string; garrisonBand?: 0|1|2|3|4; status: string }
interface PolitySatellite { key: string; parent: string; tier: Rung; at?: WorldPointCm /* its frozen site's point (the canon's sites slot); absent: an orbit-only satellite, neither drawn nor projected (`W_POLITY_SATELLITE_UNPLACED`) */; since: Week }
interface Sway { id: Id; seat: string; allegiance: Id; cells: Uint32Array /* fine */; border: WorldPointCm[][]; poleCm: WorldPointCm; neighbours: { sway: Id; class: 'kin'|'respect'|'neutral'|'adversarial' }[]; exclave: boolean; reason: Id }
interface Allegiance { id: Id; root: string; members: { seat: string; word: string; depth: number; continuous: boolean; verdictSource: 'host'|'map' }[]; name?: NameRef /* the DM's christening only, on a host-bound world */; revision: number }
interface MarchHold { pair: [string, string]; segment: Id | { wild: WorldPointCm } /* a debatable segment, or — where the two sways never touch — the fought-over wild: the midpoint of the seats' line in wild land, `borderSegment`'s fallback (V13 §3.9 (11), §3.11.6; J397 (M19)), a mark that carries the band and has no cells to decide */; side: string; band: 0|1|2|3; since: Week }
interface SwayRevision { rev: number; week: Week; causes: Id[]; dirtyBox: { c0: number; r0: number; c1: number; r1: number }; law: Hash64; keyframe: boolean; medianRung: number /* the realm's held median prosperity rung in force (V13 §3.9 (7)) */ }
interface SwayTrace { rev: number; cells: Uint32Array; former: Uint16Array; formerStatus: Uint8Array }   // between keyframes only (V13 §2.6)
interface PatrolCadence { route: Id; fromStation: number; toStation: number; power: string; everyWeeks: 1|4|13|null; basis: 'hostWatch'|'garrison'|'debatable'; rev: number }
interface RouteGenesis { lawVersion: string; edges: { hostKey: string; a: string; b: string; mode: 'land'|'water'; grade: string }[]; week: Week }
interface NetworkChange { hostKey: string; kind: string /* the host's word, mapped by the adapter folder's network table to chartered, promoted, demoted, abandoned, revived, facet, bypass or retract */; grade?: string; avoids?: string /* a bypass: the seat the host's detour avoids */; radiusM?: number /* a bypass: the host's avoidance radius, integer metres, the adapter converting the host's unit */; facet?: Record<string, string>; via?: WorldPointCm[] /* a charter's course hint */; week: Week; window: AdvanceWindow }
interface WorldWhere { kind: 'settlement'|'wall'|'road'|'border'|'supplyLine'|'region'|'point'|'offStage'; seat?: string; edge?: string; mode?: 'land'|'water'; fraction?: { num: number; den: number }; pair?: [string, string]; at?: WorldPointCm }   // resolved at fold, kept as a dated fact
interface PartyPlacement { id: Id; where: WorldWhere /* where the party IS, by the DM's hand: a `settlement` (its seat key), a `point` (`at`), a `road` with its `fraction`, a `region` — anywhere; never `offStage`; AT A PAIR where `pair` names two seats (the pin card's **Between this and…**: an act between two settlements) */; week: Week /* the world week of the placing: the document's week, or a week the DM back-dates to, never later (`refuse.world.pinDate`) */; audience: 'public'|'dmOnly' /* `public` by default — the players see where they are; `dmOnly` where the DM withholds it */; note?: string /* the DM's words ("teleported from the Rift") */; present?: { seats: string[] /* the host keys sent: one, or two for an act at a pair */; afterSeq: number /* the last lens window's `seq` folded when it was sent */ } /* set exactly when the placement is AT a host-bound settlement or pair and dated at the document's week (the host's present) on a world whose host sends the party's whereabouts (J400 (9)); a back-dated placement there is a map-only placement and sends nothing: the DM's present-at act sent to the host (`requestPartyPresent`, V13 §3.11.6); its state DERIVED at read from the lens plates and never written by them (the presentation inputs write nothing): PENDING (`W_PARTY_PENDING`) while no window later than `afterSeq` has folded, CARRIED where the first such window's `LensFacts.partySeats` name the same seats, SUPERSEDED where it names other seats or none — the host is the writer, and the party is drawn at the host's place */; reason: Id }   // THE PARTY PIN (J399 (R4); ONE WRITER, J400 (9)): the party's position is the DM's pin — the party may teleport, fly or leave the road, so the map never computes its journey: the placements are a dated LIST and never a path (no line, arrow or ETA between two placements, no day count), written by `setPartyPin` (V13 §4.1). On a STANDALONE world the pin is the party's only writer, its latest placement the party's current place, with no observer and no news delay (there is no host). On a HOST-BOUND world the party's place is the HOST'S — its whereabouts of the party on its presentation rows (`LensFacts.partySeats`, with `partySource` and `partyStamp`) — and a placement is one of two kinds: AT a host-bound settlement or pair and dated at the document's week, the DM's own present-at act, sent to the host and drawn pending until the host's next window carries it (`present`); OFF every host-bound settlement, a map-only picture of the DM's narration, which feeds the map's own known set and nothing the host reads. The party's CURRENT place on a host-bound world is the host's whereabouts, ALWAYS; a map-only placement later than the host's `partyStamp` is drawn BESIDE it as the DM's narration ("where the game master narrates them, week n"), never in its place, and a pending one as pending; where the host does not send the whereabouts (V13 §8.5's H39 unlit) nothing is sent, no current place of the party is drawn and every placement is drawn as the DM's narration. Read by the party's known set (`RenderedWorld.known`), the `partyPin` layer (V13 §5.1), the VTT scene's party notes (V13 §5.4) and V15's reach through `renderAt`'s known set; NEVER by the party observer or the default-preset news delay, which read the host's `partySeats` alone (V13 §5.8 (7)); in the entities block (the records digest), never a model input, never in the canon or the map feed, never a view key — the party key's `places` (V14 §2.3) say what the party knows, the pin where the DM puts it
interface CampaignRecord { campaign: string /* the host's campaign key */; name: string /* the host's campaign name as sent: the history labels' word */; fromWeek: Week /* the campaign's week 0 on the WORLD CLOCK: 0 for the first campaign; for a sequel its predecessor's `toWeek` + `gapWeeks` */; gapWeeks: number /* the gap the DM declared at the binding, `gapYears` × 52 (the travel law's four quarters of 13 weeks), default 0: campaign time the cover's recovery and succession run over and nothing geological — the formation op and the living physics never read it */; toWeek?: Week; closed?: { seq: number } /* set when the campaign closes (`closeCampaign`, or its successor's `bindCampaign`): `toWeek` its last window's end on the world clock; a closed campaign's weeks are read-only (`refuse.world.campaignClosed`) */; seats: { hostKey: string; placement: Id }[] /* the seats it bound, kept at its close so a later campaign's settlement may re-bind to the seat it stood at (`SettlementFacts.stoodAs`; V13 §3.11.6) */; canons: number[] /* the canon versions the host adopted under it (`canonized`), kept read-only */; reason: Id }   // THE WORLD'S HOST BINDING (J399 (R1)): one record per campaign ever bound to this world, exactly one OPEN (no `closed`) while a host is bound — a world is never bound to two live campaigns (`refuse.world.campaignLive`) —, every earlier campaign kept as the world's history under its name and clock: its lens and cover plates, sway revisions, dated events, disturbances and canon versions stand where they are, dated on the one WORLD CLOCK every record of a world is dated on (`Week` everywhere in this volume is a world week; the host's week w of the live campaign is world week `fromWeek + w`, translated once at the port's fold and once at its offers, V13 §3.11.6's law (11); a single-campaign world has `fromWeek` 0 and nothing changes); in the entities block (the records digest), outside the model digest and the canon; the history labels read "before this campaign: {name}, its year n" for a week of an earlier campaign (n = ⌊(week − its `fromWeek`) ÷ 52⌋ + 1) and "between {A} and {B}: n years after {A}" for a week of a gap (V13 §5.1, §5.8 (8))
type PastRef = { ref: string /* the host's fact reference: the key of one fact of its realm past (`PastFact.ref`) */; years: number /* whole years before the campaign's week 0, ≥ 0 (0: within the year before it) */ };   // one shape for every past read (J400 (14)): a pact's past reference and a tie's or a relation's past `since`; drawn "n years before the campaign" and never converted to a week
interface PastFact { ref: string /* the host's fact reference, unique within the campaign's past */; kind: string /* the host's word through the adapter folder's event table: a founding, a war, a pact, a razing, a succession, a naming … */; years: number /* whole years before the campaign's week 0, ≥ 0 (0: within the year before it) — never a week: a fact carrying a week, or no years, is refused at fold (`refuse.world.pastDate`) */; seat?: string /* the host key of the seat it happened at */; pair?: [string, string] /* or the two seats it bound */; pencilled: boolean /* true while the host's realm past holds it pencilled — at the campaign's birth every fact is —; false once the first advance inks it inside that advance's one commit, and true again where the host's undo of the first advance un-inks it */; text: string /* the host's own sentence for the fact, drawn as sent */; audience: Aud /* folded DM-only where absent */ }
interface PastFacts { campaign: string /* the `CampaignRecord` whose realm past this is */; facts: PastFact[] }   // THE REALM'S PAST (J400 (21); the host's offered route, accepted: V13 §8.5's H48): the host's history of the realm before a campaign, read READ-ONLY through the port's past window (`pastWindow`, V13 §3.11.6) — a recorded input, a windowed replace per campaign, sent with the birth window and again whenever the host inks or un-inks its past or the DM edits it in the host —; kept per `CampaignRecord` in the entities block (the records digest), outside the model digest and the canon; read by NO stage and never by the sway, the cover fold or a lens plate; drawn only as dated facts at seats and pairs — no geometry: no border, route, fill or line — in the scrub's and the campaign history view's **realm's past** — a strip of its own per campaign whose host sent a past, ahead of the world clock and claiming none of its weeks, counted back in years from that campaign's first week —, labelled pencilled or inked (V13 §5.1's `events` row, §5.2, §5.8 (8); `CampaignTimeline.past`, V13 §2.4), and read by the legend's past reads (`PastRef`) and V15's old map; a fact dated before week 0 has no channel in the other windows; never an earlier campaign (law (9) of V13 §3.11.6: an earlier campaign is a record of play on this world, the realm's past the host's history before a campaign)
interface TimeDeltaReceipt { baseline: number /* the canon version the host read (`canonized`) */; legs: { a: string; b: string; foot: [number, number]; army: [number, number]; bandsCrossed: string[]; fragile: boolean }[]; causes: Id[] }
interface HostGateRef { pairKey: string; cellA: number; cellB: number; atCm: WorldPointCm }   // an imported legacy world's host gates as world points (V13 §3.15 (3))
// @plat/world/lens — the lenses (V13 §5.8, §5.9; J-V13.87 – J-V13.95): derived layers over the facts the host sends of its simulated systems; never a stage, never in a digest
type LensId = 'plague'|'sway'|'patrols'|'trade'|'populations'|'religion'|'prosperity'|'alignment';   // `world.lens`'s order (J384 (8)): plague first, then the sway (the owner's territory) and patrols, trade and populations, religion, prosperity and alignment
type FactClass = 'hostStored'|'hostDerived'|'placement'|'mapDerived'|'dmPlaced';   // the four classes of host mark, and only four, beside the DM's own world sites (V13 §5.8 (4))
type GateExpr = { lane?: string /* a host lane lit, by the adapter folder's lane table */; canon?: boolean; slot?: 'seaLanes'|'teleport'|'seasonal'; beliefs?: boolean; deity?: boolean /* a deity seated anywhere */; plague?: boolean /* a plague live */; born?: boolean /* the campaign runs its birth defaults (`HostRegime.born`) — a rules regime, not a world's generation state; no note of V13 §5.8 (3) is gated on it; false, whatever its value, where the window sends no regime */; intensity?: string /* the regime runs this intensity (`HostRegime.intensity`), by the adapter folder's lane table; false where no regime or no intensity is sent */;
  sent?: string /* a port field the host sent non-empty */; all?: GateExpr[]; any?: GateExpr[]; not?: GateExpr };
interface LensLayer {                         // one per lens: a row of `world.lens` (V13 §2.3) with its element functions; drawn by one code path (V13 §5.8 (1))
  id: LensId; asked: string /* the owner rule that asked for it */; subject: string /* the host system it draws, by the adapter folder's system table */; order: number;
  sources: { field: string /* a port field: `LensFacts.plague`, `PolityFacts.seats`, the `WorldEvent` kinds tagged with this lens … */; gate: GateExpr }[];
  regimes: { word: string; when: GateExpr; reason: string /* the banner's sentence in this volume's words */ }[] /* the first whose `when` holds names the regime; the last is the lens's still word */;
  elements: LensElement[]; events: string[] /* the event kinds it reads, by the adapter folder's event table */;
  legend: { vocabulary: string /* the adapter folder's word table for this lens */; polarity?: string /* the polarity table */; notes: { text: string /* in this volume's words (V13 §5.8 (6)) */; when: GateExpr /* the note stands only where this holds */ }[] /* the bias and authorship notes (V13 §5.8 (3)), each a row of `world.lens` with its gate */ };
  refusals: { what: string; reason: string }[] /* V13 §5.9's refusals, enforced: a draw asked for one is refused (`refuse.lens.invented`) */ }
interface LensElement { key: string; class: FactClass; placed?: boolean /* a host fact positioned by map geometry (a seat area, a likely road, a site point), labelled */; grammar: 'glyph'|'link'|'routeFlow'|'movingMarker'|'catchment'|'areaFill'|'overlay'|'caption'; reads: string[]; gate: GateExpr;
  audience: 'dm'|'public'|'believed' /* the most it may reach; each row's own resolved audience narrows it */; scrub: 'hostDated'|'plate'|'swayRevision';
  label?: string /* the derivation label a host-derived, placement, placed, map-derived or DM-placed mark carries: "by the host's law", "likely road", "likely carriage", "projection", "DM-placed" */; style: string /* a `style.world` row */ }
interface HostRegime { born: boolean /* the campaign runs its birth defaults, no preset applied */; canon: boolean /* the host's canon marker */; slots: { seaLanes: boolean; teleport: boolean; seasonal: boolean } /* its frozen record's */;
  lanes: Record<string, boolean> /* each host lane, by the adapter folder's lane table */; deitySeated: boolean /* true only once a deity is seated at a seat by the DM's act: at a birth naming a capital the host OFFERS the account's top-ranked custom deity as the capital's patron, and only the DM's confirm seats it — declined or left alone, nothing is seated; an account without custom content is offered nothing (J400 (4); V13 §8.5's H36): false at birth until that confirm, the religion lens reading its `none` regime meanwhile (V13 §5.9 (6)) */; plagueLive: boolean; beliefs: boolean /* it records per-observer belief */; intensity?: string /* the host's intensity word, by the adapter folder's lane table, when sent */ }
type Aud = 'public'|'dmOnly';   // a row's resolved audience; a row the host sends without one is folded dmOnly (V13 §5.8 (7))
type Believed = { asOfWeek: Week /* the week the host last updated the belief */; confidence: 0|1|2|3 /* the host's confidence banded in quarters by the adapter folder's belief table */; integrity?: 'clean'|'worn'|'planted' /* the host's integrity register word for the belief's telling, where sent (H40) — DM-only: dropped from the party's set at fold (V13 §5.8 (7)) */ };   // a believed row's age and confidence (J397 (M8)): every believed mark draws "as of week n" and fades by its band (`LensRule.believed`; V13 §5.9); a believed row with neither is refused at fold (`refuse.lens.invented`, "a believed row with no age")
type LensGood = { key: string /* the host's catalog key as its supply links key the good (`arrivals[].good`), never its label */; label: string /* the host's own label, as its dossier shows it */; loose?: boolean /* the host reached the key only by its loose reading, when sent */; category: string /* sent by the host with the good; its word drawn through the adapter folder's goods table */; ships: boolean /* sent by the host: whether its caravans ship the good — never derived here from the category */; transit?: boolean /* sent by the host: an entrepôt's transit good */ };   // a good or a service as the host's goods catalog keys it (J380; V13 §5.9 (4))
interface LensLink { lens: LensId; a: string; b: string; kind: string /* the host's word, by the adapter folder's link table */; status?: string; weight?: number /* a band the host computed by its own law: a host-derived mark */; deity?: string; since?: Week; audience: Aud }
interface LensFacts {                         // one set of the lens window (`WorldPort.lensWindow`, V13 §3.11.6): a presentation input kept as plates; the host's words through the adapter folder's tables
  window: AdvanceWindow /* the BIRTH WINDOW's lens half: this set at seq 0, `{ fromWeek: 0; toWeek: 0 }`, at the campaign's creation, beside its polity half (`PolityFacts` at their genesis values through `polity`, V13 §3.11.6; H37; J397 (M1)) — the window every banner, plate and cover fold starts on */; audience: 'dm'|'party' /* the DM's set, or the party's believed set where the host records belief — the believed record of the party observer (V13 §5.8 (7)) */; regime?: HostRegime /* absent: `W_LENS_REGIME_ABSENT` */;
  partySeats?: string[] /* THE HOST'S WHEREABOUTS OF THE PARTY in this window (J400 (9); H39): one seat, or two for an act at a pair — the place the host's party record holds (the DM's present-at in the host, else the last heard), sent on every set of the window, the DM's and the party's alike; on a host-bound world the one writer of the party's place: read by the party observer rule, the default-preset arm, the party's known set (V13 §5.8 (7)) and the `partyPin` layer (V13 §5.1); absent where the host does not track the party — then no observer seat, no news delay, and the DM's pin a map-only picture (`PartyPlacement`) */; partySource?: 'present'|'heard' /* how the host holds the whereabouts: the DM's present-at act in the host (`present`), or the last heard (`heard`) — the adapter folder mapping the host's own source words onto these two — the legend's "the party is at {seat}" or "last heard at {seat}, week n" */; partyStamp?: Week /* the week the host's whereabouts were set, on the world clock (V13 §3.11.6's law (11)) */; partyHome?: string /* the party's home seat: a field of the host's party record the DM sets, asked of the host at its party unit (H39) — the observer's fallback (V13 §5.8 (7)) */; observer?: string /* on the party's set: the court whose believed record the set is — the court of the one seat `partySeats` names, else (a pair, or none) the home seat's (`partyHome`), as the host resolved it (H39; J397 (M8); a pair's own observer the host's party unit's to rule: until it does a pair reads the home seat's court, failing closed); absent on a set the host resolved to none */;
  courts?: { court: string /* the believing court, by its seat key */; subject: string; allegiance?: string /* the court's believed allegiance label for the subject, mapped by the adapter folder's link table to a root and a member word */; strengthBand?: 0|1|2|3|4; readiness?: string; faith?: string; believed: Believed; audience: Aud }[] /* a court's believed political facts, asked on request for a court viewpoint (H40; J397 (M9)) — HELD by the host (J400 (10)): its projection carries the DM's truth and the party's believed rows and never a court's view, so this field stays ABSENT until the host's information program rules a court's view; meanwhile the court viewpoint and the court audience draw their degraded arm, the public record within the court's reach (V13 §5.9 (2)); once sent, the sway lens projects them as that court's picture (V13 §5.9 (2)) — a presentation input like every row here, never a canon input (law (3) of V13 §3.11.6) */;
  plague?: { seat: string; phase?: string /* the host's phase word: its epidemic ledger's, on the canon only */; band?: 0|1|2|3 /* that ledger's level on the host's own edges */; source?: string; carrier?: string /* only from the host's per-hop receipt (V13 §8.5's H24) */; arrivedWeek?: Week; onsetWeek?: Week; clearWeek?: Week;
    footprint?: boolean /* a same-week spread (without the canon; on it, the migration and service joins the host keeps): no source, no time */; stage?: string /* a footprint row's stage word */; severity?: number /* a footprint row's band */; believed?: Believed /* on a row of the party's set (the "heard of plague" mark) — required there, absent on the DM's (J397 (M8)) */; audience: Aud }[];
  faith?: { seat: string; patron?: string /* a deity key */; shares: { deity: string; pct: number; standing?: string /* the host's local rank word for the deity at the seat */ }[] /* integers, Σ 100; '' the unaffiliated */; piety?: number; contested?: boolean; rulerDiffers?: boolean; disorder?: number;
    suppressed?: string[] /* the deity keys the host holds suppressed at the seat — the DM's set only: a party set's are dropped at fold (V13 §5.8 (7); J379) */; believed?: Believed /* on a row of the party's set (the believed faith label): required there (J397 (M8)) */; audience: Aud }[];
  hierarchy?: { superior: string; member: string; deity?: string; audience: Aud }[]; faithPlaces?: { seat: string; word: string /* the host's held label */; deity?: string; audience: Aud }[];
  realmPiety?: number /* the host's realm piety, sent where its spread lane is lit */; fracture?: { seat: string; severity: number /* the host's band */; audience: Aud }[] /* its conversion-fracture stressor's affected seats */;
  realmRank?: { deity: string; tier: string /* the host's tier word, ordered, highest first, by the vocabulary table's tier order */; seats: number /* its patron seats: the only driver of its tier */; wins: number; losses: number; audience: Aud }[] /* the host's realm ranking of its deities (J380's "global diety rankings"); public where its allowlist has it */;
  catchments?: { seat: string /* the rite's own seat */; members: string[] /* the seats the host's draw read for that occurrence — a set it computes and today drops, sent once H23 surfaces it */; act?: string /* the rite's act word */; deity?: string /* the rite's deity, when it has one */; week: Week; audience: Aud }[] /* a grand rite's pilgrim catchment, only when sent: never recomputed here */;
  rites?: { seat: string /* the adopter, or the vassal */; origin: string /* the settlers' origin, or the overlord */; kind: string /* the host's word: adopted or imposed */; year: number /* the host's year: it keeps no week */; deity?: string; audience: Aud }[] /* the host's adopted and imposed rites with their origin, only when sent */;
  links?: LensLink[] /* channels, faith carriers and fronts, the plague forecast, faith pressure and prescription, tolerance pulls, the patrons' quadrant postures */;
  arrivals?: { consumer: string; source: string; good?: string /* the supply link's input good, by its catalog key (`LensGood.key`), when sent */; week: Week; load?: number; audience: Aud }[];
  economy?: { seat: string; produces: LensGood[]; needs: LensGood[] /* its necessity imports and trade dependencies */; exports: LensGood[]; imports: LensGood[]; services: LensGood[] /* its sellable services */;
    foodCoverage?: { pct: number /* the host's import coverage over its raw food deficit — both its dossier's per-day figures — computed by the host on send, integer percent; never its import-dependency percent, a different measure */; cut?: string /* the siege or occupation stressor whose import cut is in force — it removes the seat's import dependency, not this share — by the stressor's own word, never the war's besieged (V13 §5.8 (6)) */ };
    stocks?: { good: string; band: string /* the host's stock band word */ }[]; throughput?: { in: string; out: string } /* the host's inbound and outbound throughput words */;
    entrepot?: { centrality: number; toll: number /* both in hundredths: the adapter's integer rounding of the host's 0–1 values, the toll in the host's median-hop units */; since?: Week /* the week its sustained centrality began; absent when the host holds none */; audience: Aud } /* the host's entrepôt record for the seat */;
    audience: Aud }[] /* J380's "imports, exports, production, consumption, of goods and services": each settlement's economy as the host's dossier judges it at its last survey; stocks, throughput and the entrepôt only where the host's finite stocks run on the canon */;
  journeys?: { traveller: string; kind: string; path: string[] /* the host's frozen settlement path */; legs: { from: Week; to: Week }[] /* its leg clock */; audience: Aud }[];
  transfers?: { from: string; to: string; people: number; kind: string; week: Week; audience: Aud }[];
  columns?: { id: string; from: string; to: string; people: number; departWeek: Week; arriveWeek: Week; carriage?: 'road'|'sea'|'teleport' /* only when the host stores the dispatched route (H27) */; cargo?: { faith?: string /* a deity key the host says the column carries */; plague?: boolean /* the host's plague-touched stamp on the column */ } /* what the host says the column carries, only where the host's own lane applies it: drawn on the marker as the host's fact, labelled, and never guessed (J397 (M24); V13 §5.9 (5)) */; audience: Aud }[];
  sizes?: { seat: string; population: number; audience: Aud }[]; trend?: { seat: string; sign: -1|0|1 /* by the host's law */; believed?: Believed /* on a row of the party's set: required there (J397 (M8)) */; audience: Aud }[];
  prosperity?: { seat: string; band: string /* the party's believed band word: rows of the party's set only — the DM's set reads `PolitySeat.prosperity`, whose public audience is the host's printed word (V13 §2.2's knowledge paragraph) */; believed: Believed /* its age and confidence (J397 (M8)) */ }[];
  pulses?: { week: Week; deltas: { seat: string; delta: number }[]; outcomes: { seat: string; severity: number }[]; audience: Aud }[] /* once, at first bind: the host's kept per-advance records, at most its 80 (V13 §5.8 (8)) */;
  alignment?: { seat: string; law: 0|1|2; malice: 0|1|2 /* the host's own bands of its own reading, normalised by the polarity table */; aggression?: string /* its chip word; absent in the host's neutral band */; causes?: string[] }[] /* the DM's set only (J384 (7)) */ }
interface LensPlate { seq: number /* the window's */; week: Week /* its toWeek */; sets: LensFacts[] /* the DM's and the party's */; rungs: { seat: string; rung: number }[] /* the window's polity rungs */;
  key: boolean /* a whole plate; else a delta on the previous kept plate */; pinned: boolean }   // the world document's plate cache (`Document.lensPlates`, BCR-V13-38), outside every digest (V13 §2.7, §5.8 (8))
// @plat/world/solve — the requirement solver's records (V13 §3.0, §3.1, §3.11; the spine's §4 and §5; J-V13.117 – J-V13.123): the pipeline IS the solver; these are its inputs, its conflicts and its answers
type Rank = 1|2|3|4|5;   // the precedence ladder (V13 §3.11.5 (1)): 1 a placed or included settlement's dossier facts; 2 the DM's overrides and locks; 3 the user's requests; 4 physical plausibility; 5 randomness
type Strength = 'random'|'set'|'locked';   // every option's three states (V13 §3.1 (1)); `random` the default of every option
interface OptionChoice { option: string /* a `world.presets` option key: size, template, scenario, latBox, poles, wind, biomeMatrix, seats, density, ruggedness, wetness, landShare, climateBand, … */; strength: Strength; value?: unknown /* absent under `random`: the sentinel is the absence */; region?: { box: { c0: number; r0: number; c1: number; r1: number } } /* a choice scoped to a region (a locked region, a regional reroll) */ }
interface Requirement { id: Id; source: 'option'|'inclusion'|'settlement'|'relation'|'lock'|'override'|'edgeCharter'|'hostRequires'|'frame'|'context';
  rank: Rank; kind: 'extent'|'latBox'|'poles'|'wind'|'template'|'scenario'|'landShare'|'ruggedness'|'wetness'|'biome'|'resource'|'site'|'relation'|'coast'|'river'|'lake'|'climateRow'|'latitude'|'terrain'|'route'|'edge'|'lockRegion'|'overrideLayer'|'water'|'landform'|'context'|'density'|'polity'|'names';
  // `landform` (file r item 1007): a feature asked for by kind — `target: { feature: 'range'|'rift'|'escarpment'|'sea'|'strait'|'basin'|'volcanicField'; extentKm2?: number; at?: { box } | { side: 'N'|'E'|'S'|'W' } | { corner: 'NE'|'NW'|'SE'|'SW' }; bearingCdeg?: Cdeg }` — the world dialog's landform and water chips (V09 §4.22 (5)) and a continuation's accepted reconciling feature (V15 §3.4 (5)); satisfied by the formation op where a scenario runs (its regional feature or a profile laid at the place asked), else by W1's `range`, `trough` or `strait` ops with `origin: 'solver'`, verified by W1 at the asked extent and reported `W_REQUIREMENT_UNMET` with the offer `moreRelief` when it cannot
  target: unknown /* the kind's value: a biome id with an amount in km² (a `biome` row of source `inclusion`), a settlement's facts (`SettlementFacts`), a relation (`{ a; b; word; travelDaysMax? }`), an edge charter's station set, a region's cells, an option's value … */;
  strength: Strength; scope?: { box: { c0: number; r0: number; c1: number; r1: number } } | { landmass: number } | { seat: string }; settlement?: string /* the host key the requirement belongs to (sources `settlement`, `relation`, `frame`) */;
  status: 'met'|'partly'|'unmet'|'pending' /* the verification report's row (V13 §3.1 (7)); `pending` before its verifying stage ran */; verifiedBy?: StageId; reason?: Id /* the reason record of the verification (`whyCell`'s form: "arid at 180 mm/yr in the Greyspine's shadow") */ }
interface SettlementFacts { hostKey: string; tier: Rung; population?: number; terrain: string /* the host's terrain word through the adapter folder's terrain table → a relief class, a coast flag and side, a river flag (DR1's row) */; access: string /* its route word through the adapter folder's route table → coast, river, road, crossroads, isolation */;
  climateRow: string /* V11's `ClimateRow`, from the terrain word by DR42's rule (the dossier carries no climate field of its own) */; latitudeBand?: [number, number] /* from `site.culture` (DR29) where the host sends a culture */; resources: string[]; phase?: 'draft'|'canonized' /* the host's phase: what an `updateDossier` will do there (H32) */; editLaw?: { effect: 'rederive'|'reroll' /* what an `updateDossier` on this settlement does under the host's law in force: `rederive` its pinned re-derivation, `reroll` only while an older path of the host's still re-rolls (J397 (M33); H32) */; warning?: string /* the host's own warning for that path, shown as sent */; exposure?: { economy: boolean; food: boolean } /* whether its economy or food would feel a world-fact change there (H32) */ } /* the host's edit law for this settlement, sent with its phase: what `Conflict.preview` reads before any request (`hostEffect`, `hostEconomyFelt`); absent, the preview reads `unknown` */; lake?: boolean; coastSide?: 'N'|'E'|'S'|'W'; riverInflow?: boolean /* the three read from the settlement's OWN base document where one exists — its DR1 site's coast and side, lake and river inflow — never asked of the host, which holds no coast side, lake or latitude on a settlement (J393); absent, the row reads `random` */; stoodAs?: string /* the host key the same saved settlement bore in an EARLIER campaign on this world, where the host knows it (H47): the include run re-binds it to the seat that campaign's `CampaignRecord.seats` names (`bindSeat` on that placement) instead of placing it anew (J399 (R1); V13 §3.11.6); absent, a new settlement, placed as an addition */ }   // the included settlements' facts (`CampaignFacts`, V13 §3.11.6; H31), each fact a rank-1 requirement of kind `terrain`, `coast`, `river`, `lake`, `climateRow`, `latitude`, `resource` or `route`
interface CampaignFacts { campaign: string; version: number; settlements: SettlementFacts[]; relations: { a: string; b: string; word: string /* the host's relation word through the adapter folder's relation table: partner, rival, overlord, vassal, ally, hostile, isolated */ }[] }   // the port's recorded input for "based off of my settlements" (V13 §3.11.6): a windowed replace keyed by host keys, sent and KEPT per campaign (J399 (R1), (R2): the live campaign's set is the include run's and the best form's; a closed campaign's last set stays with its `CampaignRecord`, read-only; a run with several campaigns included reads one set per campaign, each its region, V13 §3.1 (5)); its settlements' `population`s are what the cover fold reads at the campaign's creation — the birth fold (V13 §5.8 (9); J397 (M1)), the birth window's `sizes` winning where the host sends both; the party's home seat is no campaign fact — it is a field of the host's party record, sent as `LensFacts.partyHome` (J400 (9); H39)
interface Conflict { id: Id; requirement: Id; action: EditRef | 'generate' | 'placeFrame' | 'physicsPass' | 'reroll'; rankOfAction: Rank; rankCrossed: Rank /* the higher rank the action would change: 1 a dossier fact, 2 an override or a lock (V13 §3.11.5 (1)) */;
  settlements: string[] /* every affected settlement — one stroke may touch several */; group?: Id /* the fold's row group (J397 (M30)): every conflict of one action, one `rankCrossed` and one `what[].field` carries the same group, and the list draws the group as ONE row with "for all" over the same choices, each settlement listed within it; a `decide` with `forAll` decides every conflict of the group, each its own `Decision` (V13 §3.11.5 (1)) */; farField?: { precipDiffMm: number /* the downwind precipitation diff at the settlement from the whole-march re-run (V13 §3.14.2 step 1b) */; distanceKm: number /* from the action's box */ } /* a climate-class shift the whole march made far from the stroke: its group's row shows the diff beside the question */; what: { field: string; from: unknown; to: unknown }[] /* the facts that would change: a dossier's climate row, a locked region's cells, an override's value */;
  choices: ConflictChoice[] /* the choices this conflict admits: `moveTown` never under `hostLocked`; `changeRequest` at generation only; `updateDossier` only where a dossier fact is crossed */;
  preview: { dossierFields: string[]; hostEconomyFelt: boolean | 'unknown' /* whether the host's economy or food would feel it, read from `SettlementFacts.editLaw.exposure` where the host sends it (H32), else unknown */; hostEffect: 'rederive'|'decreeAtNextAdvance'|'retcon'|'reroll'|'unknown' /* what the host will do with an `updateDossier` (H32; J397 (M33)): `rederive` on a draft — the host's own edit law: its computed facts re-derived with every chosen fact pinned, its people, trades and history kept, the preview reading "its computed facts re-derived; its people, trades and history kept"; `decreeAtNextAdvance` on a canonized settlement's "the land changed" — a decree applied at the next advance; `retcon` on a canonized settlement's "it was always so" — the host's retcon path under its own guards; `reroll` the legacy word the host sends only while an older path of its still re-rolls, shown with the host's own warning as sent; `unknown` where the host sent none — from `SettlementFacts.phase` and `.editLaw.effect` (the warning `.editLaw.warning` shown as sent), never the map's own guess; the host's `dossierUpdated` carries the same word for what it did */; settlementMap: 'nothing' /* the settlement map does nothing by itself: its surroundings read the new land cover at view time; regenerating the town's own ground is a separate, explicit act (`worldWins`) */ } }
type ConflictChoice = 'cancel'|'fitWorld'|'paintAround'|'keepMismatch'|'updateDossier'|'moveTown'|'changeRequest';
interface Decision { id: Id; conflict: Id; requirement: Id; choice: ConflictChoice; kind?: 'landChanged'|'alwaysSo' /* `updateDossier`'s two kinds, offered by the settlement's phase: on a canonized settlement a dated host event at the advance it lands on (the default; the old biome kept in the host's history) or the host's retcon path under its own guards; on a draft `alwaysSo` alone — a pinned re-derivation under the host's own edit law, never a re-roll (J397 (M33); `Conflict.preview.hostEffect` `rederive`) */;
  by: 'user'|'preset' /* a preset pre-decides map-side choices only: `updateDossier` is never `by: 'preset'` (J-V13.122) */; week: Week; restsOn: Hash64 /* the hash of what the decision rested on — the settlement's facts, the dossier's version, the area's lock state, the requirement's target — re-asked when it moves (V13 §3.11.5 (1)) */; hostSeq?: number /* an `updateDossier` carried out: the host's confirmation (`dossierUpdated`); absent while `W_DOSSIER_PENDING` stands */ }
interface VerificationReport { run: { seq: number; goal: 'generate'|'leastChange'|'arrange'; rung: 'coarse'|'fine' }; rows: { requirement: Id; status: 'met'|'partly'|'unmet'; by: StageId; reason: Id }[]; backSteps: { from: StageId; to: StageId; cause: Id /* the requirement */; op: number /* the correction's op index */ }[];
  unmet: { requirement: Id; offer: 'largerWorld'|'widerLatBox'|'moreRelief'|'paint'|'none' }[] /* a requirement that cannot be met at the asked size says so and offers the fix; the run never fakes the result (V13 §3.1 (7)) */; conflicts: Id[] }   // written to `derived` at every run's end: the world dialog's "what was done" and the clerk's "why this desert"
interface SolveResult { ops: RecipeOp[] /* the corrections, `origin: 'solver'`, each naming its requirement */; placements?: Placement[] /* `leastChange`: the three offers; `arrange`: the member placements */; report: VerificationReport; conflicts: Conflict[] /* shown before the run commits: the run pauses at an approval point and continues after `decide` */ }
interface ArrangeMember { placement: Placement /* subject kind `world` (file r item 1030) */; extentCm: { w: WorldCm; h: WorldCm }; rung: WorldSizeRung; coarseCellCm: Cm /* the member's coarse cell: the search's lattice step */; locked: boolean }   // the `'arrange'` goal's state (file r item 1007; C15-05): a placement carries no extent, rung or lock of its own
declare function solve(requirements: Requirement[], state: WorldDocument | { members: ArrangeMember[] } | null, goal: 'generate'|'leastChange'|'arrange', opts?: { rung?: 'coarse'|'fine' /* absent under `'arrange'`, which runs no world stage */; decisions?: Decision[]; seed?: Seed; maxIterations?: number /* `'arrange'`: the least-change search's bound, the caller's cell (V15's `atlas.arrange.leastChange.maxIterations`) */ }): SolveResult;   // @plat/world/solve: the pipeline's one entry (V13 §3.0) — never a second engine; V15 calls it with `'arrange'` over map placements (the spine's §14.5), each member's extent, rung, coarse cell and lock beside its placement; a locked placement is a rank-2 `Requirement { source: 'lock'; kind: 'lockRegion'; target: { placement: Id }; strength: 'locked' }`; an atlas requirement carries no `scope` (the state is the whole atlas)
interface ArrangeEvaluator { kind: Requirement['kind']; word?: string /* a `relation` kind's word (V15 §2.3's table: `eastOf`, `acrossSea`, `inside`, `farFrom`, `adjacent`, `beyondUnknown`) */; cost(req: Requirement, members: ArrangeMember[]): { cost: number /* 0 when met; the measure's error otherwise */; detail: string /* `whyCell`'s form, the report's reason */ } }
declare namespace solve { function registerEvaluator(e: ArrangeEvaluator): void }   // the `'arrange'` goal's one registration path (file r item 1007; J-V13.132): a caller registers its kinds' evaluators once, before its first `solve`, as V14 registers its siting terms through `terms.register` (V13 §3.7); under `'arrange'` the engine runs a deterministic least-change search over the placements — each step moves the one unlocked member whose move lowers the summed evaluator cost most, by the smallest step on a lattice of the members' own coarse cells (`ArrangeMember.coarseCellCm`), ties by the lowest member ordinal, until no move lowers the cost or `opts.maxIterations` is reached — under the ladder (rank 2 locks held; rank 3 relations before rank 4 compatibility before rank 5 the caller's packing, V13 §3.11.5 (1)), writes the verification report and the conflicts, and runs no world stage (T-V13-68 (f)); a kind with no evaluator is `unmet` with the reason `noEvaluator`; V15 registers its atlas-scale kinds (V15 §2.3)

// the DM's two verbs on every physical layer (V13 §3.14.1; the spine's §7.1; J-V13.129)
interface Override { id: Id; layer: 'biome'|'soil'|'landCover'|'current'|'terrain' /* `terrain`: an `alwaysSo` `setField` stroke is already the base's — listed so one record form names every always-so paint */; cells: Uint32Array /* fine (biome, soil, landCover), coarse (current) */; value: number | { u: number; v: number } /* the class id, or the current vector in the raster's unit */;
  since: { seq: number; week: Week }; released?: { seq: number; week: Week; keptAsHistory: boolean } /* a physics pass's `release`: the override no longer binds; kept as a visual trace or removed, the DM's choice */; reason: Id }   // an always-so override: a boundary condition of every dirty set that touches its cells, never overwritten by a re-derivation (V13 §3.14.2); rank 2 of the ladder
interface Disturbance { id: Id; kind: string /* an OPEN row id of `world.cover`'s `recovery` table (J397 (M37)) — never a closed union: the shipped rows `fire`, `flood`, `clearing`, `eruption`, `ashfall`, `lavaFlow`, `razing`, `plague` (the mundane kinds), the example rows `blight`, `curseScar` and `wildMagic` with recovery laws of their own, and a DM's custom rows through the content volume's custom path (V11 §3.13; BCR-V13-55), each with its recovery stages; `razing` and `plague` arrive as host events the DM attributes; a kind with no row is refused at the stamp (`refuse.world.disturbKind`) */; cells: Uint32Array /* fine */; week: Week; severity: number /* 0–1 */;
  source: 'user'|'host' /* a DM's stamp, or a host `WorldEvent` the DM attributed — never by itself, as a host flood raises no surface by itself (V13 §3.11.6) */; event?: Id /* the `WorldEvent` */; reason: Id }   // a this-happened disturbance: dated, the land recovers by the succession table from its week (V13 §3.6 (5)); never undone by physics, never erased by a reroll
interface CoverPlate { seq: number /* the lens window's, or the disturbance's event seq */; week: Week; cover: Uint8Array /* fine; `world.cover`'s class per land cell: the potential vegetation's own class where unused and undisturbed, else field, pasture, coppice, fallow, scrub, regrowth, young forest, burn scar, flood silt, ash, lava, bare */;
  eventWeek: Uint16Array /* fine, sparse-coded: the cell's last dated event's week (0 none) */; eventKind: Uint8Array /* fine, sparse-coded: the recovery row's registered ordinal — the shipped rows first, then the example and custom rows in registration order */; demand: { seat: string; count: number }[] /* per seat the cells its use met at this plate, counted in the seat's fixed travel-time order (V13 §3.6 (5) (a)): the dated series a withdrawn cell's week is read from — one integer per seat per plate, never a class (J397 (M26)) */; key: boolean /* a whole plate; else a delta on the previous kept plate */; pinned: boolean }   // the cover cache (`Document.coverPlates`, BCR-V13-41): one per host advance and per dated disturbance, outside every digest, re-derivable from the recipe, the event log and the windows' populations, read by no stage (V13 §3.6 (5), §5.8 (9))

// formation's entities and knobs (V13 §3.2.1; J-V13.107 – J-V13.111)
interface Landform { id: Id; kind: 'range'|'volcano'|'caldera'|'rift'|'fault'|'hotspotChain'|'glacialLake'|'fjord'|'cirque'|'plateau'|'basin'|'trench'|'arc'|'ria'|'raisedBeach'|'suture'|'escarpment'; outline: WorldPointCm[][] /* rings in world cm (the formation grid's cells traced) */; crest?: WorldPointCm[] /* a range's, rift's, arc's or escarpment's spine */;
  heightM?: number /* the peak, or the depth */; formed: { scenario: string; feature: 'boundary'|'hotspot'|'relict'|'glacial'|'seaLevel' } /* the bake's provenance in words, so the clerk can say "a collision range of the young-range scenario"; no block state */; active?: boolean /* a volcano or a fault the DM marks active: a hazard reading the host may read (`SettlementPhysical.hazards`); an eruption is a `Disturbance` the DM stamps, never a roll */;
  name?: NameRef /* W9's `range` kind, now with a producer */; reason: Id }
interface FormationKnobs { blocks: number /* the crust blocks on the formation grid (the continent rung's model; 1–2 at the realm rung as a regional context; 0 at the province rung, which takes one regional feature) */; continentalShare: number /* 0–1 */; speedMmYr: [number, number] /* the blocks' relative speeds, drawn in the range */; ageMyr: number /* the orogeny's age: a young range stands high and sharp, an old one worn */;
  relictSutures: number; iceExtent: number /* 0–1: the glacial maximum's reach, an ELA depression scaled */; seaLevel: { glacialM: number; stands: number } /* the sea-level history: the glacial low and how many stands */; drama: number /* a multiplier on the boundary density, 1 Earth's */; hotspots: number }   // the five shipped scenarios' knob ranges are `world.formation`'s rows (V13 §2.3); W0 draws each on `world.recipe` unless the dialog set or locked it

// the seams owed to V15 (the spine's §14; J-V13.127)
interface WorldEdgeCharter { version: string; world: Uuid; side: 'N'|'E'|'S'|'W'; span: { fromCm: WorldCm; toCm: WorldCm } /* the stretch of the edge shared */; stationCm: Cm /* one station per coarse cell along the span */;
  stations: { atCm: WorldCm; demCm: Cm /* the fine DEM's mean at the station */; bedrock: number; soil: number; biome: number /* the potential natural vegetation, graded by the neighbour's own ecotone */; water: 'land'|'sea'|'lake'; tableCm: Cm;
    monthly: { tempDeciC: Int16Array; precipMm: Uint16Array; windCdeg: Uint16Array; windStrength: Uint8Array; moisture: Uint16Array /* the march's moisture arriving at the station per month — how a rain shadow continues */; maritime: Uint8Array } }[];
  riverCrossings: { reach: Id; atCm: WorldCm; direction: 'in'|'out'; dischargeM3s: M3s; bedCm: Cm }[]; landforms: { kind: Landform['kind']; crest: WorldPointCm[]; heightM?: number }[] /* those that run off the edge */;
  currents?: { psiMonth: Float32Array[] /* twelve: the stream function along an open-sea span per month, so each month's net transport is continuous */ }; overrides: { layer: Override['layer']; atCm: [WorldCm, WorldCm]; value: Override['value'] }[] /* the neighbour's always-so overrides along the edge — their cells are already the present ground; carried so the continuation holds them as boundary conditions */;
  latBox: { southDeg: number; northDeg: number }; datum: 'sea0'; world: { poles: { equatorDeciC: DeciC; poleDeciC: DeciC }; calendarSouth: boolean } /* the neighbour's present climate inputs at world level (a pole `adjust` moves the present climate, which the charter reads): a continuation's W0 pre-fills them as `set` choices (C15-03) */; neighbourVersion: string /* the neighbour's model digest at emission */; reason: Id }   // `FrameCharter`'s sibling one rung up: the neighbour's PRESENT PHYSICAL GROUND along the edge at the moment of emission, never a record — the test is J393's, "is this a present physical fact (terrain, bedrock, soils, landforms, water bodies at their present level, river crossings at their present flow, climate, currents, groundwater), however it came to be?" (T-V13-68): an always-so override and a this-happened disturbance that have shaped the ground are both in it, since both are the ground; it NEVER carries a dated record — an event, a land-cover class, a plate, a political fact, simulation state — nor any change made after it was read (F14); produced by `edgeCharter(world, side, span, line?)` (`line` the station line's offset inward from the named side; absent, the world's own edge — a `WorldCharter`'s four edges are read at the extent's sides, `line` their offsets, §3.11.4; file s item 1033), consumed by W0 as locked requirements (V13 §3.1 (6)); V15 only carries it (the spine's §14.1)
interface RenderedWorld { doc: Uuid; week: Week /* the week drawn: the world's present unless asked otherwise */; presentWeek: Week; dateLabel: string /* the host's calendar words where bound, else the season control's */; rung: WorldSizeRung; extentCm: { w: WorldCm; h: WorldCm }; datum: 'sea0'; latBox: { southDeg: number; northDeg: number };
  tiles: { stop: 0|1|2|3; set: Id /* the §8.1 tile set at that stop for the audience, drawn over the `atlas` layer set (V13 §5.4) */; labels: { box: [number, number, number, number] /* px */; text: string; kind: string; priority: number }[] /* the label boxes §9.2's placer placed at that stop, in the member's pixel frame at the stop (file r item 1007; V15 §3.3 (5)): the picture's own metadata, so a seam can drop a yielding member's labels whole */ }[]; known: { audience: 'dm'|'public'|`party:${string}`|`court:${string}`; cells: Uint32Array /* coarse: the cells the audience's places have reached (V14's layers through the world's `knownTo`) and, for a party audience, the seats of the host's whereabouts of the party (`LensFacts.partySeats`) from each window's `partyStamp` and the cells of the DM's map-only party placements from their weeks (on a standalone world every placement's; a present-at placement counts once the host's row carries it, as the host's seats) — never a cell between two places (J399 (R4); J400 (9); V13 §5.8 (7)); for a court audience the court's own reach — its seats' territories and sways, the cells within its travel weeks along routes, the far ends of its channels, its allies' and vassals' seats and one heard-of band (V15 §3.6 (4); J397 (M9); file y item 1241) */ }[] }   // `renderAt(world, week, audience)`'s reading — tiles over the `atlas` layer set with their label boxes, extent, datum, latitude box, rung, present week, date label and the known sets per audience — and nothing else (the spine's §14.2); a view read, never persisted
interface WorldCharter { version: string; parent: { doc: Uuid; version: string }; extentCm: { x0: WorldCm; y0: WorldCm; w: WorldCm; h: WorldCm } /* the child's extent in the parent's frame, axis-aligned, bearing 0 */; rung: WorldSizeRung /* the child's, finer than the parent's — or the parent's own for a carved member, whose ground is copied one to one (J399 (R2); V13 §3.1 (8)) */;
  edges: WorldEdgeCharter[] /* four: the parent's present ground along each side of the extent (`edgeCharter(parent, side, span, line)` — the side's span along the extent, `line` the side's offset inward from the parent's own edge of that name, fixed by `extentCm`: interior lines of the parent, never its boundary), `side` the child's side */; ground: { cellCm: Cm; cols: number; rows: number; dem: ChunkRef[]; bedrock: ChunkRef; soil: ChunkRef /* no `biome`: the child's W5 re-classifies from its own months, and the edge grading reads `edges[].stations[].biome` (C15-17) */ } /* the parent's rasters over the extent at the parent's fine cell, read once at emission: the child's COARSE ground, which its W1 upsamples bilinearly as a baked formation-grid DEM is (V13 §3.2) and refines by the position-keyed lattice and its own ops */;
  plannedSites: Requirement[] /* the parent's placed frames inside the extent as rank-1 `site` rows of source `frame` (origin, bearing and the charter's facts): the child's W0 lays them as planned sites (V13 §3.1 (5)); a frame belongs to one world (V13 §3.18 (7)), so the frames stay the parent's until the user moves them (V15 §3.5 (a)) */;
  reason: Id }   // the world-first order one rung up (V13 §3.11.4; the spine's §10.6 "derived from the parent"): emitted by `requestCharter` with a world subject (a `Placement` of subject kind `world` on the parent, `precedenceStamp: 'world'`, P4 only, no blend) and, record-less, by `charterFor` at a world-rung `TransientPlacement`; the parent's PRESENT physical ground as it stands at emission (V13 §2.2's test, J393) — never an event, a cover class, a plate, a route or a political fact, nor any later change; stored in the child's recipe as `WorldRecipe.parentCharter` (provenance, never re-read); produced by V13, consumed by the child's W0–W1 and by V15's fit (file r items 1007, 1009)
interface ViewFacts { doc: Uuid; week: Week; audience: 'dm'|'public'|`party:${string}`;
  faith: { hierarchy: LensFacts['hierarchy']; faithPlaces: LensFacts['faithPlaces']; patrons: { seat: string; patron?: string; contested?: boolean }[]; realmRank: LensFacts['realmRank'] } /* V13 §5.9 (6)'s rows */;
  polity: { allegiances: Allegiance[]; sways: { id: Id; seat: string; allegiance: Id; neighbours: Sway['neighbours']; poleCm: WorldPointCm; areaKm2: number; border: WorldPointCm[][] /* the sway's outer ring(s) at the coarse grid's tolerance; its `cells` only on request */ }[]; seats: { seat: string; at: WorldPointCm /* the placement's origin, or the glyph's point on a standalone world */; tier: Rung; sizeThird: 0|1|2; prosperity: number; population?: number }[]; medianRung: number; relations: PolityRelation[]; culture: PolityFacts['culture']; cultures: { id: number; label?: NameRef /* the DM's christening; absent on a host-bound world unless the host sent one */ }[] } /* V13 §3.9, §5.9 (2), (5), (7); the positions, extents and the culture table a drawing reader needs (C15-02, C15-03) */;
  trade: { seat: string; entrepot?: { centrality: number }; exports: number }[]; channels: LensLink[] /* V13 §5.9 (4): the trade lens's channels */;
  events: WorldEvent[] /* the kinds the caller names, within the window it names, each with its resolved audience and its `at` or `seats` (V13 §2.2) */; routes: WorldRoute[] /* every route of both modes in the network in force at `week`, with its polyline, `stations` and `sailing` (V13 §3.8): the land routes V15's itinerary, travel-time readout and known region read through `derivedTime` over the stations (V15 §3.6 (1) (c), (3), (4)); file s item 1050 */; water: { stormFactor: number[] /* per quarter, the law in force */; bathymetry?: { cellCm: Cm; cols: number; rows: number; depthM: Int16Array } /* on request: the coarse `dem` below the datum over the ocean cells, 0 on land — one reading per member for V15's sea rules, never a reading per cell (C15-03) */ };
  absent: string[] /* the facts the host never sent, by field name, so the caller's legend can say so (V13 §5.8 (3)) */; reason: Id }   // `viewFacts(world, week, audience)` (V13 §5.8 (10); file r items 1007, 1012): one reading from the plates at `week` (V13 §5.8 (8)) and the event index, filtered by audience as V13 §5.8 (7) filters a lens — never the alignment lens, a suppressed creed, a covert link or a criminal channel; a row the host resolved DM-only never returned for a player audience; fact class 4 at its reader (an owner-ruled projection, labelled); a view read, never persisted; the relational style's one reading beside `renderAt` (the spine's §14 (4))

// sail routing (V13 §3.8 (12); J-V13.125)
interface SailingLeg { route: Id; vessel: 'sail'|'oared'|'coastal'; month: number; direction: 'out'|'back'; effortM: number /* integer sea effort-metres: Σ over the laid course of the segment's length ÷ its ground-speed share (the polar at the wind angle, + the current's along-track share, − leeway, + the tacking penalty) */;
  course: WorldPointCm[]; tacks: number; closed: boolean /* a standalone world only: the month set's risk at its cap (V13 §3.8 (12)); never on an offered effort */; reason: Id }   // a pure function of the live wind and current fields and the coast; no random weather (storms stay the host's storm season, applied once by the host; an offered effort carries wind and current only, J393); cached in `derived` per (lane, geometry version, climate version), never a digest
```

**The frame's side** (BCR-V13-2, BCR-V13-3, BCR-V13-5): `Terrain` gains `carveDeltaCm: Map<number, number>` (per hydro
cell, the delta S1 (3)'s carve lowered it by; `preCarveHeightAt(p)` = `heightAt(p)` + the cell's delta), `surfaces:
WaterSurface[]` (one generation-time surface per `WaterBody` — the sea at `seaLevelCm`, each lake at its spill height,
each reach's stage profile — and every dated surface after it) and `groundwater: GroundwaterField` (`grid: 'hydro'`);
`Terrain.datumCm` and `Terrain.wind` stay exactly what S1 wrote and are read only through the accessors `datumOf(doc)`,
`windOf(doc)` and `sunAt(doc, week, hour)` (`@plat/model`): on a standalone frame each returns S1's value (the datum,
`Terrain.wind`, the sun from the recipe's `Intent.latitudeDeg`, DR29); on a placed frame `datumOf` returns the world's
DEM at the placement's origin and `windOf` the charter's wind in frame terms, **each read through the world document
named by `worldRef` at call time — a derived reading, never stored in the frame** (Revision 1, C13-01: no placement
writes a field the model digest hashes; bar 3). The model-side sun (§4.5's daylight term, field pass 1) stays the
recipe's latitude until a `worldWins` re-derives the frame; a placement whose latitude differs from the recipe's is a
`PlacementAnomaly` kind `sunDiffers` (V13 §3.11.5). `Document` gains `worldRef?: { world: Uuid; placement: Id }`
(written only by the frame's own `charter` event, V13 §4.1) and `Recipe` gains `charter?: FrameCharter` (present exactly
when the frame was generated or re-derived from a **world-sourced** charter, `source: 'world'`; a settlement-first
placement's charter lives on the world's `Placement` alone, C13-03) and `product: 'world'` with `Recipe.world`. The base's water-table rule (§2.6 *Basements*; SW-23) is replaced by `waterTableAt(doc, p, when?)`
(V13 §3.12.3). A standalone frame — no `worldRef` — keeps every base behaviour: `datumOf` returns S1's value, the
surfaces are S1's at generation, the groundwater field is derived from them, and the charter is absent.

**Knowledge on world facts.** Every world entity above carries `knownTo` as §9.2's admission reads it on a frame's
entities (`'public'|'local'|'secret'`), default `public` for physical facts and `local` for a `SitingProposal`; V14's
five knowledge layers (exists, DM knows, players know, players reached, discoverable) are V14's reading of the same key
with its `SiteAnchor`'s flag, stated there; this volume adds no fourth tier. **Host facts carry the host's resolved
audience** (J-V13.77): a host fact the host resolves public is `public`; one it reserves for the DM is DM-only — V14
§2.3's `SecretState` state `dmOnly`, so its geometry is withheld with it; a fact the host hides is never sent; a host fact
arriving with no resolved audience is stored DM-only; `local` is admitted on a world only through the party's places. One
mapping serves world events and the dossier conditions a frame draws.

### 2.3 New rule tables (data, editable by `editTable`, §7.6; every cell `{value, unit, provenance, calibratable}`)

Every value below is **our own** (provenance `own`, `extension`), PLAUSIBLE until measured (V13 §12), calibratable
against the corpus when its stage comes (§13.9; the `M-CAL/world` run, V13 §8), save the cells marked *physics* — a
published physical constant (the lapse rate, the seconds in a year) — which carry provenance `physics` and are not
calibratable. Where a value leans on the reference generator's published behaviour the note names the research file and
section as evidence, never as a source of the number; every number is this volume's. The tables join V11's registry as
new rows (`world.*`, `place.*`, `water.*`; V11 §3.1's next free row numbers, assigned at W1's landing, V13 §8).

```ts
interface WorldSizeRow { rung: WorldSizeRung; widthKm: number; heightKm: number; fineCellM: number; coarseRatio: number; formationRatio: number /* the formation grid's fine cells per side, 4 (V13 §3.2.1) */; formationMs: number /* the formation op's own budget beside `budgetMs` (V13 §6) */;
  defaultLatBox: [number, number]; budgetMs: number /* V13 §6 */; reliefLimitM: number; docMb: number /* the gzipped document budget, V13 §2.7 */; exportStride: number /* the ecosystem export's cells per fine cell, V13 §5.4 */ }   // world.sizes
interface RecipeOpRow { op: RecipeOp['op']; params: Record<string, [number, number] /* the admitted range, metres or a share */>; cost: number | 'octaves×2' | 'passes×3' /* work units per touched fine cell (V13 §6): hill, pit, strait, mask, invert, add, multiply, image, geology 1; range, trough 2; noise octaves × 2; smooth 3 × passes */ }   // world.recipeOps
interface ClimateWorldRule {                                                                                   // world.climate — W3
  tropicsDeg: number; lapseDeciCPerKm: number; seasonAmpMaxDeciC: number; seasonContinentalShare: number; continentalityReachKm: number;
  phaseWeekNorth: number; phaseWeekSouth: number;
  winds: { fromDeg: number; toDeg: number; bearingCdeg: Cdeg; strength: number }[] /* the annual-mean belts (a world's recipe may override); the twelve monthly belt sets are these shifted by `belts` (V13 §3.4 (5)) */;
  belts: { itczDeg: number; itczSwingOceanDeg: number; itczSwingLandDeg: number; subtropicalOffsetDeg: number; polarFrontDeg: number; lagMonths: number; landFetchKm: number } /* the three-cell system and its seasonal shift per column by its land fraction (V13 §3.4 (5)) */;
  thermal: { onshorePerDeciC: number; monsoonReversalDeg: number; wetHalfShare: number } /* the land–sea thermal term and the monsoon test (V13 §3.4 (5), (6)) */;
  maritime: { efoldKm: number } /* the maritime fraction's e-folding length over land (V13 §3.4 (3)) */;
  cascade: { livePreviewBand: boolean } /* every relief or water edit re-runs the whole monthly march and every basin (V13 §3.14.2; J393: no threshold); true lets a live brush preview a local re-march of the edited band during the drag, the commit running the whole */;
  currents: { betaEqPerM: number; viscosityM2s: number; drag: number; cycles: number; sstWarmDeciC: number; sstColdDeciC: number; upwellingDeciC: number; coastalReachKm: number; pickupPerDeciC: number } /* the basin gyre solve and its coastal effect (V13 §3.4 (6b)) */;
  moisture: { pickupPerCellOverWater: number; dropShare: number; orographicPerM: number; coastalBonus: number; barrierM: number; rainCapMm: MmYr; convergenceMmPerMonth: number; frontalMmPerMonth: number; convectiveMmPerMonth: number; recycleShare: number } /* the march per month (V13 §3.4 (6)): the first six as before, the annual values read per month ÷ 12; the belt rains and the recycling added */;
  evap: { baseMm: MmYr; zeroAtDeciC: DeciC; fullAtDeciC: DeciC } }
interface HydroWorldRule {                                                                                      // world.hydro — W4
  lakeMinDepthCm: Cm; breachToleranceCm: Cm; runoffShare: number; riverMinM3s: M3s; navigableM3s: M3s;
  width: { a: number; b: number }; depth: { c: number; f: number }; chaikinPasses: number;
  mouth: { deltaSlopeMax: number; deltaReachKm: number; estuaryWidenShare: number; estuaryReachKm: number /* W6's coastType reads it */ }; exitDropCm: Cm;
  carveMaxCm: Cm /* the world's carve cap (V13 §3.5.2) */; maxReachCellsFactor: number /* a reach's trace cap, × the grid's longer side (V13 §3.16) */;
  tidalRangeCm: Cm /* every sea's default tidal range; a lake 0 (V13 §3.12.7) */; importSeaDepthM: number /* the import's bathymetry (V13 §3.15) */;
  secondsPerYear: number /* physics: 31 557 600 */ }
interface GroundwaterRule {                                                                                    // world.groundwater — W4 and the frame's step
  gradientBase: number /* m per m, at precipRefMm */; precipRefMm: MmYr; permeability: Record<'ordinary'|'soluble'|'volcanic'|'impermeable', number>;
  minDepthCm: Cm /* the table never rises above ground − minDepth except at a spring cell */; perchDepthCm: Cm; springMarginCm: Cm; springSpacingM: number;
  springMinAccumCells: number; liner: { headLimitCm: Cm } /* V13 §3.12.6 */; deepTableCm: Cm /* F-GW's dry table (V13 §3.16) */ }
interface BiomeRow { id: string; label: string; habitability: number /* 0–1 */; moveCost: number; landUse: 'ice'|'tundra'|'forest'|'grass'|'scrub'|'desert'|'wetland'|'alpine'; vegetation: number /* 0–1 */; climateRow: string /* one of V11 §2.8's ClimateRow.biome keys (the mapping table below; C13-16) */; colour: Color /* the view's fill (V13 §5.1) */ }
interface ResourceSite { id: Id; kind: string; at: WorldPointCm; cell: number; amount: number /* 0–1 */; reason: Id }   // W5's resource record (V13 §3.6)
interface BiomeMatrixRow { id: string; moistureBands: MmYr[] /* the upper bounds of the moisture columns */; tempBands: DeciC[] /* the upper bounds of the temperature rows */; cells: string[][] /* biome ids, [tempRow][moistureCol] */;
  overrides: { water: string; permafrostBelowDeciC: DeciC; wetlandAccumCells: number; alpineAboveM: number } }   // world.biomes
interface SuitabilityRule { weights: Record<'habitability'|'discharge'|'lowland'|'coastType'|'resource'|'spring'|'destination'|'connectivity', number>;
  discharge: { refM3s: M3s }; lowland: { refM: number }; coastType: Record<'none'|'open'|'bay'|'estuary'|'lake'|'saltLake', number>;
  spacing: { capitalKm: number; townKm: number; shrink: number; targetShare: number; capitalPerKm2: number; townPerKm2: number }; portPromote: number; minPortsPerBody: number;
  reach: { estuaryKm: number; resourceKm: number; siteKm: number; overlookKm: number; roadControlKm: number; settlementKm: number }; navigableBonus: number; coastalHabitabilityBonus: number;
  stage2: { connectivityRefRoutes: number } }   // world.suitability — W6a, W6b
interface RouteCostLaw { version: number /* the host's cost-law version; 0 the default row */; landBase: number; perM: number; slopePerPct: number; biomeFactor: Record<string, number> /* the default row: each biome's moveCost */;
  classFactor?: Record<string, number> /* the host's per-terrain-class factor through the adapter folder's class table; when present it replaces biomeFactor */; elevationKneeM?: number; elevationKneeFactor?: number /* the host's elevation knee: a step above it costs × the factor */; riverCellAdd?: number /* the host's add on a river cell */;
  riverCrossing: number; waterPerM: number; seaPerM: number; navigableRiverPerM: number;
  bears: Record<string, 'time'|'choice'> /* each term's tag: the base, the per-metre and slope terms, the knee, the river-cell add and the class factors bear time; riverCrossing bears choice; a host law carries its own tags */ }   // world.routes — the host's law as data (a host slice, `costLaw`; the default row ours): W7, W8a, W8b, derivedTime
interface RouteLayRule { existingRoute: number; portOnly: boolean; classes: { primaryShare: number }; routeToleranceM: number; maxCostFactor: number;
  sea: { trunk: boolean /* every well-ported landmass gets one sea trunk to the largest landmass */; gapFixRatio: number /* a port pair whose sea cost ≤ ratio × its land cost gets the sea leg too */ }; exitRunM: number /* a placed frame's road run through the margin to its gate station */ }   // world.routeLay — the map's own network formation (W7); never the host's, never a time
interface PolityRule {                                                                                       // world.polity — W8a, W8b (V13 §3.9); every cell {value, unit, provenance, calibratable}
  reach: { lambda: number; reachTierDays: Record<Rung, number> /* Λ·τTier in foot-days */; capFactor: number /* capTier = capFactor × reachTier */; kSize: [number, number, number] /* log-linear: 1.15^(third − 1) */; kProsperity: number[] /* by the relative rung −3 … +3 (V13 §3.9 (7)), lowest first; log-linear: 1.1^(relative rung) */ };
  culture: { phi: number /* the step slowing at a culture distance of 1 */; dwellWeeks: number }; water: { lodgementDays: number }; river: { crossingDays: number /* added to t at a step across a reach ≥ navigableM3s: the sway's own resistance, never a route time */ };
  margins: { civ: number /* L */; mil: number /* bands */; muPerBand: number /* L */; pushPerBand: number /* L per band of the host's strength order (V13 §3.9 (8)) */; strengthDwellWeeks: number };
  military: { tauMilDays: Record<'seat'|'fort'|'watchpost'|'bridgeFort'|'tollhouse'|'tower', number>; garrisonBonus: number /* bands added to a source's force band where a garrison is present */; offRoadFactor: number; dwellWeeks: number };
  chain: { delta: number; depthMax: number; bMax: number; wTier: Record<Rung, number>; wTributary: number; rho: number /* L */ };
  march: { halfLifeWeeks: number; bands: number; muHoldPerBand: number /* L */; fightingWeeks: number }; prosperityDwellWeeks: number; prosperityClamp: number /* the relative rung's bound (V13 §3.9 (7)) */;
  patrol: { cadenceWeeks: [1, 4, 13]; hostileDays: number; gradeShift: Record<string, -1|0|1>; forceShift: { denserFromBand: number; sparserToBand: number } };
  normalize: { enclaveMaxCells: number; spikeMaxCells: number; smoothPasses: number }; province: { perSeatCells: number; minCells: number }; polePrecisionM: number;
  retention: { keyframeEvery: number; thinAfterYears: number } }
interface WorldLabelRule { priority: Record<'sea'|'lake'|'river'|'range'|'territory'|'province'|'settlement'|'site', number>; zoomExtent: Record<string, [number, number]>; spreadPx: number; riverMinKm: number }   // world.labels — W9
interface GlyphLevelRow { level: 0|1|2|3; fromStop: number; toStop: number; marks: GlyphMark['kind'][]; toleranceM: number; minTier: Rung; fromStopByTier: Record<'THORP'|'HAMLET'|'VILLAGE'|'TOWN', number> /* the first stop a tier draws at this level (C13-52) */ }   // world.glyph — W9 and the view
interface CoherenceRule { weights: Record<CoherenceCost['terms'][number]['term'], number>; lawfulMax: number; bearingStepCdeg: Cdeg; originSearchM: number; originStepCells: number;
```
